source_checklist.locator: Zhang et al. Nat Commun 2023 doi:10.1038/s41467-023-40411-w; PMC10400590

pass_1.finding: Describes ChemGenes barcode bead chemistry, blocked 19-nt complement, droplet bisulfite conversion, random priming and indexed PCR; points to Supplementary Fig. 1.

pass_2.locations: Original PMC10400590 JATS title/byline lines 3-23; Methods lines 189-219 (bead design, fusion, bisulfite, random priming, two PCR stages)
pass_2.finding: Defining article is Zhang et al., not Liu or Fu. ChemGenes custom lot L142464-1 bead has photocleavable linker, common PCR arm, 15-base A/T/G cell barcode and ligation site; a 19-base 3′-blocked complement is annealed. UV release and ligation precede droplet bisulfite; Klenow random priming, P5/P7 pre-PCR and N5XX/Ad2.XX index PCR follow. Exact oligos are delegated to Supplementary Fig. 1.

source_checklist.reason: Audit-trail source identity correction: previous locator called the defining DOI Liu et al.; original JATS title/byline lines 3-23 identify Zhang Qiang as first author.
